title: David:
title_short: Reel · David · Only About a Hundred
headline: A volunteer who was too nervous to go inside found another way in: he answers the growth work incarcerated men write by hand. Asked for one moment that touched him, he says: only about a hundred.
story: David is a volunteer. He was nervous about being vulnerable in a prison with people he did not know, so he started with the correspondence program: incarcerated participants write their growth work on paper and send it in; trained volunteers spend hours writing back; the pages go back to the author. A year later he went inside too. This reel is about the letters, not the prison.

Loops: L1 “A hundred what?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:03 (“every time I read what somebody has done”). L2 “What does he get back?” opens 0:00 and closes in the BUTTON (“get out of your comfort zone … you will never look back”). Stakes: men who are treated as second-class citizens get a page back that says they matter. The volunteer gets as much as they do.
